provenance.method: Current GOV.UK Disabled Students' Allowance overview and 2026 to 2027 forms guidance reviewed for an England scheme-scope claim.

title: Disabled Students' Allowance application forms and notes for 2026 to 2027
citation: Student Loans Company and Department for Education, Disabled Students' Allowance application forms and notes for 2026 to 2027, GOV.UK, updated 27 August 2026.
authorship: Student Loans Company and Department for Education

contributions.finding: The official 2026 to 2027 DSA application material applies to England and sets the current application/evidence route for eligible students seeking disability-related study support.
contributions.population_or_context: Students using the Student Finance England DSA route for the relevant academic year.
contributions.methodology: Authoritative government/student-finance application guidance rather than an outcome study.

limitations.text: Application rules, evidence requirements and support decisions can change by academic year and depend on individual eligibility.
limitations.why_it_matters: The evidence supports the existence and scope of the England route, not an individual award decision.
reopening_or_reduction_conditions: Recheck when a new academic-year DSA route or major eligibility change is published.
